titles.en: The Snake, the Trap, and the Dog

continuity.opening: Released from prison, Pinocchio tries to return to the Blue Fairy and begin again.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio swims into the storm, determined not to abandon Geppetto again.
continuity.next: After a night in the sea, Pinocchio reaches a working island and searches for news of his father.

learningObjective: Explain how consequences shape later choices using cause, contrast, confession, and renewed purpose.

beats.title: The Road Back
beats.purpose: Test Pinocchio’s hopeful return with a comic but dangerous roadside obstacle.

beats.title: Hunger in the Vineyard
beats.purpose: Turn physical hunger into a knowingly dishonest choice and immediate consequence.

beats.title: The Watchdog’s Collar
beats.purpose: Make punishment concrete and reveal how badly Pinocchio has misused freedom.

beats.title: The Weasels’ Bargain
beats.purpose: Offer Pinocchio an easy corrupt bargain that mirrors his recent theft.

beats.title: Honesty Earns Freedom
beats.purpose: Show that truthful action cannot erase the past but can change the next outcome.

beats.title: The Fairy’s Memorial Stone
beats.purpose: Let Pinocchio face grief without escaping or inventing an excuse.

beats.title: News from the Pigeon
beats.purpose: Restore hope through news of Geppetto’s long and costly search.

beats.title: Into the Storm
beats.purpose: Transform impulsive action into a courageous attempt to repair abandonment.
